annotations.title: Get my latest AI Visibility Index score

tools.description: Get the AI Visibility Index (0-100) for the signed-in user's most recently scanned brand, broken down by engine. Requires a free Ninar account (no credit card).
tools.name: get_latest_score
tools.title: Get my latest AI Visibility Index score

tools.description: Run an AI visibility scan for a brand. Pass `city` for a local-business check (ChatGPT + Gemini, city-scoped). Omit `city` for a multi-engine GEO scan across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, AI Overviews — engine count scales with the user's Ninar plan (free = 2).

city.description: City for a local-business check. Omit for multi-engine GEO scan.

country.description: Optional ISO country: us, gb, in, eu.

use_case.description: Optional GEO use case, e.g. 'for sales teams'.

website.description: Optional brand URL for GEO citation matching.

tools.name: scan_visibility
tools.title: Run an AI visibility scan

annotations.title: List content gaps from my latest scan

tools.description: List AI-generated content suggestions (FAQs, differentiators, use cases, about copy) the signed-in user can publish to close visibility gaps found in their latest scan.
tools.name: list_content_gaps
tools.title: List content gaps from my latest scan

annotations.title: Generate AI-optimized content for a gap

tools.description: Generate AI-optimized content (FAQ, about copy, use cases, differentiators) for the gaps in your latest scan. Returns full content text inline — no need to visit the dashboard. Pro plan or higher required. Pass gap_type='all' to get every block in one call.

gap_type.description: Which content block to generate. Use 'all' for everything in one call.

tools.name: generate_content
tools.title: Generate AI-optimized content for a gap

annotations.title: Audit a brand entity via System of Record adjudication

tools.description: Check whether a brand or entity surfaced by an AI engine is a genuine competitor in your category (e.g. is 'Banner Life' actually a mortgage insurance competitor to Enact?). Uses dual-model verification with automatic escalation on disagreement. Returns a confirmed/rejected decision, confidence score, reasoning, and audit trail. Pro plan or higher required.

entity.description: Entity name to adjudicate, e.g. 'Banner Life', 'Enact Solar'.

raw_evidence.description: Source text the entity appeared in. Should contain 'raw_answer_excerpt' and optionally 'entity_sentence' and 'source_probe_id'.

taxonomy_id.description: Taxonomy registry to validate against. Default: pmi.v1

tools.name: audit_brand_visibility
tools.title: Verify whether an entity is a real competitor
